title: Portfolio
summary: PORTFOLIO, noun [Latin folium.] A case of the size of a large book, to keep loose papers in. To have or hold the portfolio is to hold the office of minister of foreign affairs.

inlines.v: PORTFOLIO, noun [Latin folium.] A case of the size of a large book, to keep loose papers in. To have or hold the portfolio is to hold the office of minister of foreign affairs.
